notes.title: New update - Tutorial
notes.notes:
Hi Golfers,

A new update is now available for the Whacky Golf demo. This update adds a tutorial to guide new players through the game's mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39951715/7041a254a3188a4251391f4a96837421881cbe6e.png

Gone is the silly blue rules sign. Now there are interactive prompts that appear in the world to show new players the ropes. The tutorial will guide you through finishing your first hole, as well as help in other ways like when to whack other golfers.

Here's a fun fact: Cbrgb lay tdfyp nb qb hqupzxmuy qdlcb nb tkenl gwb rxfs rlfamr.

Happy golfing,
Cameron

notes.title: New update - Settings changes, FOV changes
notes.notes:
Hi Golfers,

A new update is now available for the Whacky Golf demo.

This update drastically improves the FOV of the game. You will now be able to see more of your surroundings while you play. It also scales more nicely when playing in 2 player mode. Before this, it would look like it was zooming out heaps if a new player joined.

I've also added a new setting to change your screen. If your computer has multiple monitors you can now pick which one you want to play on.

Here's the full list of what's new

 Increased the FOV of the game, and made it scale more consistently in 2 player mode
 Allow switching screen in the settings when multiple monitors are connected
 Fixed some places where the mouse couldn't click on menu buttons
 Removed a font I didn't like and replaced it with one I do like
 Re-added the moving menu background
 Transition into the game should be a little smoother than before
 Fixed buggy tutorial prompts for keyboard and mouse users


The next update will be coming pretty soon, and will contain a complete tutorial.

Happy golfing,
Cameron
